items.reason_en: Unauthenticated access to OpenShift devfile endpoints facilitates SSRF attacks against internal cluster services, exposing sensitive infrastructure metadata.
items.reason_zh: 未认证访问 OpenShift devfile 端点可促成针对内部集群服务的 SSRF 攻击，暴露敏感的基础设施元数据。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in AWS GluonTS model loading permits remote code execution with pipeline privileges, threatening cloud AI/ML workflows.
items.reason_zh: AWS GluonTS 模型加载过程中的不安全反序列化允许以流水线权限执行远程代码，威胁云 AI/ML 工作流。

items.reason_en: Insecure deserialization of crafted JSON payloads in Octopus Deploy enables authenticated code execution within the CI/CD orchestration process.
items.reason_zh: Octopus Deploy 中对构造的 JSON 载荷进行不安全的反序列化，可在 CI/CD 编排过程中实现已认证的代码执行。

items.reason_en: Remote session hijacking vulnerability risks unauthorized control over enterprise infrastructure management appliances.
items.reason_zh: 远程会话劫持漏洞可能导致企业对基础设施管理设备的控制权被未授权方接管。

items.reason_en: Failure to properly clean credentials on logout allows attackers to retain access even after account termination.
items.reason_zh: 登出时未能正确清理凭证，导致攻击者在账户终止后仍可保留访问权限。

items.reason_en: Fleet agent incorrectly uses cluster-admin credentials instead of pinned ServiceAccounts, breaking multi-tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: Fleet Agent 错误地使用 cluster-admin 凭据而非固定的 ServiceAccount，破坏了多租户隔离。

items.reason_en: Improper link resolution in migration paths allows authenticated clients to write attacker-controlled files to the host filesystem.
items.reason_zh: 迁移路径中存在不正确的链接解析漏洞，允许经过身份验证的客户端将攻击者控制的文件写入主机文件系统。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in the Btrfs storage driver enables instance creators to delete or replace arbitrary host files as root.
items.reason_zh: Btrfs 存储驱动存在路径遍历漏洞，允许实例创建者以 root 权限删除或替换任意主机文件。

items.reason_en: Code injection in BOVPN client configuration handling allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root, completely compromising firewall integrity.
items.reason_zh: BOVPN 客户端配置处理存在代码注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者以 root 权限执行任意命令，彻底破坏防火墙的完整性。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the spamBlocker daemon enables arbitrary code execution by authenticated administrators, undermining network security controls.
items.reason_zh: spamBlocker 守护进程存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许经过身份验证的管理员执行任意代码，从而破坏网络安全控制机制。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled resource consumption during the wgagent login process permits unauthenticated denial-of-service attacks against critical firewall infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: wgagent 登录过程中存在未受控的资源消耗漏洞，可导致针对关键防火墙基础设施的未授权拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in Windows iSCSI allows attackers to bypass security controls and gain unauthorized network access. This compromises storage area networks (SANs) and introduces severe data exposure risks.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 存在弱认证漏洞，允许攻击者绕过安全控制并获取未授权的网络访问权限。该漏洞会危及存储区域网络（SAN），并带来严重的数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows Secure Socket Tunneling Protocol (SSTP) driver enables unauthenticated remote code execution. Exploitation could allow attackers to intercept or manipulate VPN traffic.
items.reason_zh: Windows 安全套接字隧道协议 (SSTP) 驱动程序存在释放后使用漏洞，可导致未授权的远程代码执行。攻击者利用该漏洞可拦截或篡改 VPN 流量。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Windows Routing and Remote Access Service (RRAS) grants attackers direct control over network routing devices. This facilitates network pivoting, traffic interception, and broader infrastructure compromise.
items.reason_zh: Windows 路由和远程访问服务 (RRAS) 存在远程代码执行漏洞，使攻击者能够直接控制网络路由设备。该漏洞便于攻击者进行网络横向移动、流量拦截及进一步破坏基础设施。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free flaw in the Windows DNS driver allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network. Compromising DNS resolution can lead to cache poisoning, service disruption, and further network reconnaissance.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 驱动程序存在释放后使用漏洞，允许通过网络进行未授权的远程代码执行。该漏洞被利用后可导致 DNS 缓存投毒、服务中断及进一步的网络侦察活动。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in DHCP Server enables remote code execution, threatening critical network address management and infrastructure stability.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 存在堆溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，严重威胁关键的网络地址管理功能与基础设施稳定性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the DNS client allows remote code execution, directly undermining name resolution reliability and network connectivity.
items.reason_zh: DNS 客户端存在释放后使用漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，直接破坏名称解析的可靠性与网络连接。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in RRAS compromises routing and VPN services, exposing internal networks to lateral movement and unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: RRAS 存在远程代码执行漏洞，会破坏路由与 VPN 服务，使内部网络暴露于横向移动和未授权访问的风险之中。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the SMB client enables remote code execution, leveraging a ubiquitous file-sharing protocol prevalent in enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: SMB 客户端存在释放后使用漏洞，可导致远程代码执行。该漏洞利用了在企业环境中广泛使用的通用文件共享协议。

items.reason_en: Input validation flaw in TCP/IP allows security feature bypass over the network, weakening core stack defenses against evasion techniques.
items.reason_zh: TCP/IP 协议栈存在输入验证缺陷，允许攻击者通过网络绕过安全特性，削弱了核心协议栈对规避技术的防御能力。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 use-after-free in Active Directory Domain Services enables unauthenticated network-based code execution, directly threatening enterprise identity management and authentication infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 存在评分为 8.1 的释放后使用漏洞，可导致基于网络的未授权代码执行，直接威胁企业身份管理与认证基础设施。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 stack-based buffer overflow in the DHCP Server permits unauthenticated remote code execution, risking network configuration hijacking and widespread service disruption.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 存在评分为 8.1 的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致未授权的远程代码执行，引发网络配置劫持及大范围服务中断风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 origin validation error in Windows DNS allows unauthenticated network spoofing attacks, undermining critical name resolution and enabling man-in-the-middle scenarios.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 存在评分为 8.1 的来源验证错误漏洞，允许未授权的网络欺骗攻击，破坏关键名称解析服务并支持中间人（MitM）攻击。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 integer overflow in the DHCP Server allows unauthorized network RCE, disrupting critical IP address management and network connectivity.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 存在评分为 8.8 的整数溢出漏洞，可导致未授权的网络远程代码执行（RCE），破坏关键的 IP 地址管理与网络连接。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in DNS Server enables unauthorized network RCE, targeting foundational name resolution services essential for enterprise networking.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 存在释放后使用漏洞，可导致未授权的网络远程代码执行（RCE），直接威胁企业网络所依赖的基础名称解析服务。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass by spoofing in Windows Netlogon allows adjacent network attackers to compromise Active Directory trust relationships and Kerberos flows.
items.reason_zh: Windows Netlogon 存在通过伪造实现认证绕过的漏洞，允许邻近网络攻击者破坏 Active Directory 信任关系及 Kerberos 认证流程。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows Netlogon enables remote code execution, jeopardizing Active Directory authentication and domain controller resilience.
items.reason_zh: Windows Netlogon 存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，严重危及 Active Directory 认证机制与域控制器的安全性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the DNS Server allows remote code execution, which can disrupt critical name resolution services across enterprise networks.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 存在释放后使用漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，进而破坏企业网络范围内的关键名称解析服务。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in the IP Helper API permits remote code execution, affecting network configuration, routing, and connectivity management functions.
items.reason_zh: IP Helper API 存在释放后使用漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，影响网络配置、路由及连接管理等功能。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Windows DHCP Server allows adjacent network attackers to execute code, disrupting critical address management services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许邻近网络攻击者执行恶意代码，破坏关键的地址管理服务。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Windows DNS Server permits unauthenticated remote code execution, undermining name resolution infrastructure reliability.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS Server 存在竞争条件漏洞，可导致未授权的远程代码执行，破坏名称解析基础设施的可靠性。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows IKE Extension allows network-based code execution, exposing VPN and secure tunneling mechanisms to exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Windows IKE 扩展存在堆溢出漏洞，可导致基于网络的代码执行，使 VPN 及安全隧道机制面临被利用的风险。

items.reason_en: Memory overflow vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway causes unpredictable behavior and potential remote exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Citrix NetScaler ADC 和 Gateway 存在内存溢出漏洞，会导致系统行为异常及潜在的远程代码执行风险。

items.reason_en: Malformed NAS payloads in Baicells eNodeB trigger core network shutdowns due to insufficient input validation during connection setup.
items.reason_zh: Baicells eNodeB 在连接建立时缺乏充分的输入验证，导致格式错误的 NAS 载荷可触发核心网络宕机。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows iSCSI Target Service allows unauthorized remote code execution over the network.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI Target Service 存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许通过网络进行未授权的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows DNS service permits network-based privilege escalation, threatening critical name resolution infrastructure across corporate networks.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 服务中的释放后使用漏洞允许基于网络的权限提升，威胁企业网络中关键的名称解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in HTTP.sys affects core network request handling, potentially destabilizing web services and API endpoints exposed to internal or external traffic.
items.reason_zh: HTTP.sys 中的堆溢出漏洞影响核心网络请求处理，可能导致暴露于内外流量的 Web 服务和 API 端点运行不稳定。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows DNS allows unauthenticated remote code execution. As a foundational network service, exploitation disrupts connectivity and enables widespread network pivoting.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行。作为基础网络服务，利用该漏洞会破坏网络连接并支持广泛的网络横向移动。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Microsoft QUIC enables unauthenticated remote code execution. Vulnerabilities in modern transport protocols directly impact encrypted traffic security and service availability.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft QUIC 中的释放后使用漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行。现代传输协议中的漏洞直接影响加密流量安全和服务可用性。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows LDAP allows unauthenticated remote code execution. Compromise of directory services grants attackers unrestricted access to identity management and authentication infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows LDAP 中的释放后使用漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行。目录服务被攻破将使攻击者获得对身份管理和认证基础设施的无限制访问权限。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Windows RRAS provides direct network-level access to victim machines. Attackers can leverage this to establish persistent backdoors or pivot across protected subnets.
items.reason_zh: Windows RRAS 中的远程代码执行漏洞可为攻击者提供对受害主机的直接网络级访问。攻击者可借此建立持久化后门或在受保护子网间进行横向移动。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated command injection in HPE Networking Instant ON APs allows adjacent attackers to execute privileged commands.
items.reason_zh: HPE Networking Instant ON AP 中的未经身份验证的命令注入漏洞允许相邻攻击者执行特权命令。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in HPE Instant ON AP interfaces enables unauthenticated adjacent attackers to achieve remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: HPE Instant ON AP 接口中的缓冲区溢出漏洞使未经身份验证的相邻攻击者能够实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: TCP/IP stack null pointer dereference in Windows allows unauthenticated denial of service over a network.
items.reason_zh: Windows TCP/IP 协议栈空指针解引用漏洞允许通过网络实施未经身份验证的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway allows attackers to bypass security controls and intercept or inject traffic.
items.reason_zh: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway 中的 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞允许攻击者绕过安全控制并拦截或注入流量。

items.reason_en: Memory overflow vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler components lead to unpredictable behavior and potential remote code execution in network edge devices.
items.reason_zh: Citrix NetScaler 组件中的内存溢出漏洞会导致网络设备出现不可预测的行为，并可能引发远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted dangerous file uploads in Flowring Agentflow permit authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary system commands via malicious payloads.
items.reason_zh: Flowring Agentflow 中不受限制的危险文件上传漏洞允许已认证攻击者通过恶意载荷执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Exposed GraphQL API in FreePBX allows authenticated users to execute arbitrary shell commands, compromising widely deployed IP telephony systems.
items.reason_zh: FreePBX 中暴露的 GraphQL API 允许已认证用户执行任意 Shell 命令，从而危及广泛部署的 IP 电话系统。

items.reason_en: Known exploited in the wild; input validation flaw enables unauthenticated remote code execution on critical ADC and Gateway appliances.
items.reason_zh: 野外已知遭利用；输入验证缺陷可在关键的 ADC 和 Gateway 设备上实现未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: IP defragmentation state reuse after datagram delivery allows fragmented traffic attacks to execute arbitrary code at the bootloader.
items.reason_zh: 数据报交付后 IP 重组状态重用漏洞，可使分片流量攻击在 bootloader 层面执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Authenticated path traversal in the upload API allows overwriting critical configuration files outside intended directories.
items.reason_zh: 上传 API 中的已认证路径遍历漏洞允许覆盖预期目录外的关键配置文件。

items.reason_en: Sensitive information inclusion in source code of the VPN gateway policy manager could expose internal architecture or credentials.
items.reason_zh: VPN 网关策略管理器源代码中包含敏感信息，可能导致内部架构或凭据泄露。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Dassault Systèmes GEOVIA Geospatial Data Manager enables arbitrary server-side execution, impacting industrial geospatial workflows.
items.reason_zh: Dassault Systèmes GEOVIA Geospatial Data Manager 中的代码注入漏洞允许任意服务端代码执行，影响工业地理空间工作流。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass on Hitachi Energy RTU500 firmware endpoints allows unauthenticated attackers to upload malicious firmware, disrupting operational technology.
items.reason_zh: Hitachi Energy RTU500 固件端点的身份验证绕过漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者上传恶意固件，破坏运营技术环境。

items.reason_en: Directory traversal in Hitachi Energy RTU500 file uploads enables overwriting critical system files, potentially causing permanent device failure or control loss.
items.reason_zh: Hitachi Energy RTU500 文件上传中的目录遍历漏洞可导致关键系统文件被覆盖，可能引发设备永久性故障或控制权丧失。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated configuration file upload compromises the integrity and security of critical infrastructure asset management software.
items.reason_zh: 未经身份验证的配置文件上传漏洞破坏了关键基础设施资产管理软件的完整性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in the data center monitoring system enables privilege abuse and unauthorized configuration changes.
items.reason_zh: 数据中心监控系统中的缺失授权漏洞可导致权限滥用和未授权的配置更改。

items.reason_en: Non-administrative users can write executable content under targets_modified/, which is later executed by configuration paths, enabling privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: 非管理员用户可在 targets_modified/ 目录下写入可执行内容，随后由配置路径执行，从而实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in the Azure Portal web interface facilitates network-based spoofing and potential session hijacking for administrative users.
items.reason_zh: Azure Portal Web 界面中的跨站脚本漏洞可助长针对管理员用户的基于网络的欺骗攻击及潜在的会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Capture-replay authentication bypass in the MSAL Node.js library undermines modern web application identity verification and enables spoofing attacks.
items.reason_zh: MSAL Node.js 库中的捕获重放身份验证绕过漏洞削弱了现代 Web 应用的身份验证机制，并支持欺骗攻击。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint permits authenticated attackers to execute code over the network. This flaw directly impacts enterprise content management systems and web portal accessibility.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的缺失授权漏洞允许已认证攻击者通过网络执行代码。该缺陷直接影响企业内容管理系统和 Web 门户的可访问性。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint allows network-based spoofing and credential harvesting within enterprise web portals and collaboration sites.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞允许在企业 Web 门户和协作站点中进行基于网络的欺骗和凭据窃取。

items.reason_en: Additional XSS flaw in SharePoint web page generation facilitates phishing campaigns and session hijacking against authenticated users.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 网页生成过程中的额外 XSS 漏洞助长了针对已认证用户的钓鱼攻击和会话劫持。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap-based buffer overflow in URL Moniker allows unauthenticated remote code execution when processing malicious links, significantly impacting browser and shell integration security.
items.reason_zh: URL Moniker 中评分为 8.8 的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞在处理恶意链接时允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，严重影响浏览器与 Shell 集成安全。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 incorrect numeric conversion in Microsoft JScript enables unauthenticated remote code execution, affecting legacy web applications and ActiveX-dependent environments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft JScript 中评分为 8.1 的不正确数值转换漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，影响遗留 Web 应用及依赖 ActiveX 的环境。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows unauthorized network RCE via malicious web content, impacting browser security.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge (基于 Chromium) 中存在 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许通过恶意网页内容进行未授权的网络远程代码执行，影响浏览器安全。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Visual Studio Code enables unauthorized network bypass of security features, affecting developer toolchain integrity.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可导致未授权的网络安全功能绕过，影响开发者工具链的完整性。

items.reason_en: Incomplete comparison logic in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized network security feature bypass, creating exploitable gaps in IDE protection mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的不完整比较逻辑漏洞允许未授权的网络安全功能绕过，在 IDE 保护机制中产生可利用的安全缺口。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server enables spoofing and phishing campaigns over the network, directly targeting web-based email interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本漏洞可在网络层面支持欺骗与钓鱼活动，直接针对基于 Web 的邮件界面。

items.reason_en: Session fixation vulnerability in the TopTech Systems application allows attackers to predefine and reuse session IDs, leading to straightforward account takeovers.
items.reason_zh: TopTech Systems 应用程序中的会话固定漏洞允许攻击者预定义并复用会话 ID，从而导致账户接管。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated database table export in TopTech TMS exposes sensitive organizational data without requiring credentials.
items.reason_zh: TopTech TMS 中的未认证数据库表导出漏洞可在无需凭据的情况下暴露敏感的组织数据。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary PHP file upload vulnerability in TopTech TMS allows remote attackers to achieve full server-side code execution.
items.reason_zh: TopTech TMS 中的任意 PHP 文件上传漏洞允许远程攻击者实现完整的服务器端代码执行。

items.reason_en: Double free in Microsoft Exchange Server enables unauthenticated network code execution, severely impacting enterprise email infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的双重释放漏洞可实现未授权的网络代码执行，严重影响企业邮件基础设施。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft SharePoint enables network-based spoofing attacks that can compromise user sessions and credentials.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞可引发基于网络的欺骗攻击，导致用户会话和凭据泄露。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint allows remote code execution, posing severe risks to web application infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的不受信任数据反序列化漏洞可导致远程代码执行，对 Web 应用基础设施构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in SharePoint permits unauthorized network privilege escalation, exposing sensitive enterprise content.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中缺失的身份验证机制允许未授权的网络权限提升，导致敏感企业内容暴露。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution, exploiting a common and dangerous attack vector in web collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的不受信任数据反序列化漏洞可实现远程代码执行，利用了 Web 协作平台中常见且危险的攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Another critical SharePoint deserialization flaw allows network RCE, highlighting persistent risks from insecure object handling in legacy web applications.
items.reason_zh: 另一处关键的 SharePoint 反序列化漏洞允许网络远程代码执行，凸显了遗留 Web 应用中不安全对象处理带来的持续风险。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Microsoft Copilot exposes organizations to data disclosure and potential system compromise through malicious AI-generated prompts.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Copilot 中的命令注入漏洞使组织面临数据泄露及系统被潜在攻陷的风险，攻击者可利用恶意的 AI 生成提示词实施攻击。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Microsoft Office SharePoint is actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV). It allows authenticated attackers to deploy malicious payloads, leading to data breaches and ransomware deployment.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的代码注入漏洞已在野外被积极利用（列入 CISA KEV）。该漏洞允许已认证的攻击者部署恶意载荷，导致数据泄露和勒索软件部署。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Exchange Server enables remote code execution. Compromised email servers are prime targets for credential harvesting, spam relay, and business email compromise.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行。被攻陷的邮件服务器是凭证收集、垃圾邮件中继和业务电子邮件欺诈的主要目标。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to perform spoofing attacks. This facilitates targeted phishing campaigns and session hijacking against end-users.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本漏洞允许已认证的攻击者执行欺骗攻击。此举助长了针对终端用户的定向钓鱼活动和会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Power BI permits remote code execution. As a widely adopted analytics platform, exploitation risks sensitive business intelligence data exposure and report tampering.
items.reason_zh: Power BI 中的输入验证不当漏洞可导致远程代码执行。作为广泛采用的分析平台，其被利用将导致敏感商业智能数据泄露及报表篡改风险。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的不受信任数据反序列化漏洞允许已认证的攻击者远程执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Office SharePoint enables privilege escalation and unauthorized administrative actions.
items.reason_zh: Office SharePoint 中的身份验证不当漏洞可导致权限提升及未授权的管理操作。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in libsoup during WebSocket compression can be triggered by maliciously crafted network messages.
items.reason_zh: libsoup 在处理 WebSocket 压缩时存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过恶意构造的网络消息触发。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated PHP code injection in Balbooa Forms executes raw query parameter values via eval(), granting immediate remote code execution on vulnerable Joomla sites.
items.reason_zh: Balbooa Forms 中的未认证 PHP 代码注入漏洞通过 eval() 执行原始查询参数值，致使易受攻击的 Joomla 站点立即发生远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unbounded memory allocation in urllib3's chunked streaming parser triggers denial of service when processing malicious HTTP responses in Python web applications.
items.reason_zh: urllib3 的分块流解析器中存在无界内存分配漏洞，在处理 Python Web 应用中的恶意 HTTP 响应时会触发拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization checks in Apache Roller's legacy XML-RPC APIs allow authenticated users to read, modify, or delete other users' weblog content.
items.reason_zh: Apache Roller 的遗留 XML-RPC API 中缺失授权检查，允许已认证用户读取、修改或删除其他用户的网志内容。

items.reason_en: X-SpringBoot lacks object-level authorization, enabling sub-administrators to reset super administrator passwords and rebind roles without ownership verification.
items.reason_zh: X-SpringBoot 缺乏对象级授权控制，使得子管理员可在未经验证所有权的情况下重置超级管理员密码并重新绑定角色。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated arbitrary file write via the feed endpoint allows attackers to plant malicious files and potentially compromise the entire site.
items.reason_zh: 通过 feed 端点存在的未认证任意文件写入漏洞允许攻击者植入恶意文件，并可能危及整个站点。

items.reason_en: Argument injection in the Mercurial backend can be leveraged to execute system commands or manipulate version control repositories.
items.reason_zh: Mercurial 后端的参数注入漏洞可被利用来执行系统命令或操纵版本控制仓库。

items.reason_en: Pre-authentication deserialization of vendor extensions in the XML-RPC endpoint enables unauthenticated remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: XML-RPC 端点中供应商扩展的预认证反序列化漏洞可实现未授权的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Template injection in the multipart upload handler allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution via crafted filenames.
items.reason_zh: 多部分上传处理器中的模板注入漏洞允许未认证的攻击者通过构造的文件名实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Lack of extension checks on saved MIME parts enables PHP file uploads to media directories, leading to remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: 保存的 MIME 部件缺乏扩展名检查漏洞，允许将 PHP 文件上传至媒体目录，从而导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Admin-controlled SSL settings trigger server-side template interpolation, enabling injection attacks and potential remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: 管理员控制的SSL设置会触发服务器端模板插值，从而导致注入攻击和潜在的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Personal-access-token API flow completes before two-factor challenge verification, effectively bypassing MFA requirements.
items.reason_zh: 个人访问令牌API流程在双因素挑战验证完成前即已结束，从而有效绕过了多因素身份验证(MFA)要求。

items.reason_en: Unescaped operationId parameters in OpenAPI specifications inject arbitrary JavaScript into generated TanStack Query hooks.
items.reason_zh: OpenAPI规范中未转义的operationId参数会将任意JavaScript注入到生成的TanStack Query钩子中。

items.reason_en: Insufficient sanitization in the rich text editor field allows unauthenticated attackers to store and execute malicious scripts in WordPress forms.
items.reason_zh: 富文本编辑器字段缺乏足够的过滤处理，允许未认证的攻击者在WordPress表单中存储并执行恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Azure Database for PostgreSQL enables authenticated users to escalate privileges within the managed database environment.
items.reason_zh: Azure Database for PostgreSQL中的授权不当，使已认证用户能够在托管数据库环境中提升权限。

items.reason_en: Missing resource limits in ASP.NET Core allows unauthenticated denial-of-service attacks against web applications and backend middleware services.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中缺少资源限制，导致针对Web应用程序和后端中间件服务的未认证拒绝服务(DoS)攻击成为可能。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft SQL Server allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary commands over the network. This classic vulnerability type remains highly exploitable against misconfigured database instances.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SQL Server中的SQL注入漏洞允许已认证的攻击者通过网络提升权限并执行任意命令。此类经典漏洞类型在对配置错误的数据库实例进行攻击时仍具有极高的可利用性。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server enables authenticated attackers to execute code remotely. Flawed object handling in database services often leads to full backend compromise.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中对不受信任数据的反序列化操作使已认证的攻击者能够远程执行代码。数据库服务中对象处理的缺陷通常会导致整个后端被完全攻陷。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in SQL Server allows authorized users to elevate privileges and bypass security boundaries. Weak permission enforcement in database engines frequently results in unauthorized data extraction or manipulation.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中的访问控制不当允许已认证用户提升权限并绕过安全边界。数据库引擎中权限执行的薄弱性经常导致未经授权的数据提取或篡改。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server allows remote code execution, representing a critical and well-known attack vector for database servers.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中对不受信任数据的反序列化可导致远程代码执行，这是数据库服务器面临的一个关键且广为人知的攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL enables remote code execution during database connectivity operations, targeting backend data pipelines.
items.reason_zh: SQL的WDAC OLE DB提供程序中的堆溢出漏洞可在数据库连接操作期间导致远程代码执行，主要面向后端数据管道。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits unauthorized network RCE, posing severe risks to backend data storage and transactional integrity.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中CVSS评分为9.8的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经授权的远程网络代码执行(RCE)，对后端数据存储和事务完整性构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in SQL Server allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network, directly compromising database security controls.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中的SQL注入漏洞允许已认证的攻击者通过网络提升权限，直接破坏数据库安全控制机制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables network RCE, threatening mission-critical relational database services and application backends.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现网络远程代码执行(RCE)，对关键业务的关系型数据库服务和应用后端构成威胁。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in SQL Server allows an authorized attacker to execute code over the network, posing a severe risk to critical database environments.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中的整数溢出漏洞允许已认证的攻击者通过网络执行代码，对关键数据库环境构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Microsoft Exchange Server enables privilege escalation over the network, threatening enterprise email and collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server中缺失授权检查可导致通过网络提升权限，威胁企业电子邮件和协作平台。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in SharePoint allows privilege escalation over the network, exposing enterprise content management and document sharing systems to targeted exploitation.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中的SQL注入漏洞允许通过网络提升权限，使企业内容管理和文档共享系统暴露于定向利用的风险之中。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, directly threatening data storage systems.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未认证的远程代码执行(RCE)通过网络发生，直接威胁数据存储系统。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in SQL Server enables network-based privilege escalation, allowing attackers to manipulate database structures and extract sensitive records.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中的SQL注入漏洞可实现基于网络的权限提升，使攻击者能够篡改数据库结构并提取敏感记录。

items.reason_en: Command injection in IBM Guardium's certificate export CLI allows privileged users to execute arbitrary root-level commands, bypassing security monitoring controls.
items.reason_zh: IBM Guardium证书导出CLI中的命令注入漏洞允许特权用户执行任意root级命令，从而绕过安全监控控制。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Azure SQL Database allows unauthorized network privilege escalation, directly threatening database integrity and confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database中的SQL注入漏洞允许未经授权的远程网络权限提升，直接威胁数据库的完整性和机密性。

items.reason_en: Argument injection in Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra enables remote code execution, compromising distributed database clusters.
items.reason_zh: Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra中的参数注入漏洞可导致远程代码执行，破坏分布式数据库集群。

items.reason_en: Path traversal and arbitrary file deletion in IBM Guardium Data Protection compromises system integrity and can cause denial of service.
items.reason_zh: IBM Guardium Data Protection中的路径遍历和任意文件删除漏洞会破坏系统完整性，并可能导致拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the .NET runtime allows local privilege escalation, impacting a wide range of enterprise applications built on managed frameworks.
items.reason_zh: .NET运行时中的整数溢出漏洞允许本地权限提升，影响大量基于托管框架构建的企业应用程序。

items.reason_en: Command injection in PowerShell enables local code execution, compromising automated administrative scripts and backend middleware processes.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell中的命令注入漏洞可实现本地代码执行，破坏自动化管理脚本和后端中间件进程。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Azure SQL Database allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges and manipulate database contents.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database中的SQL注入漏洞允许已认证的攻击者提升权限并篡改数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in SurrealDB HTTP session construction allows attackers to authenticate without proper credential validation.
items.reason_zh: SurrealDB HTTP会话构造过程中的授权绕过漏洞使攻击者能够在不进行适当凭据验证的情况下完成认证。

items.reason_en: Unsafe reflection in ActiveMQ Artemis instantiates classes directly from protocol buffers without type validation, enabling remote code execution in messaging brokers.
items.reason_zh: ActiveMQ Artemis中的不安全反射机制会在未进行类型验证的情况下直接从协议缓冲区实例化类，从而导致消息代理中的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in libsoup occurs when size truncation mismatches occur during large WebSocket payload masking, corrupting application memory.
items.reason_zh: libsoup中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞发生在大型WebSocket载荷掩码处理期间出现大小截断不匹配时，会导致应用程序内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Command injection in IBM Guardium's SNMP alert functionality allows authenticated attackers to execute operating system commands via manipulated policy text.
items.reason_zh: IBM Guardium的SNMP告警功能中存在命令注入漏洞，允许已认证的攻击者通过篡改策略文本来执行操作系统命令。

items.reason_en: Setting readonly=true on the execute_sql tool fails to enforce read-only mode, allowing unintended database modifications.
items.reason_zh: execute_sql 工具设置 readonly=true 后未能强制启用只读模式，致使攻击者可进行非预期的数据库修改。

items.reason_en: Trust-store plugin overrides certificate validation errors, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks by forging trusted connections.
items.reason_zh: 信任库插件会忽略证书验证错误，通过伪造受信任连接使攻击者能够实施中间人（MITM）攻击。

items.reason_en: Absence of a CA bundle silently falls back to verify_none, facilitating JWKS forgery and MITM attacks against the broker.
items.reason_zh: 未配置 CA 证书包时会静默降级为 verify_none，从而便于对代理服务器实施 JWKS 伪造及中间人（MITM）攻击。

items.reason_en: Zero byte-width in array primitive parsing causes infinite loops or memory corruption during AMQP frame consumption, leading to DoS.
items.reason_zh: 数组基础类型解析中存在零字节宽度问题，在处理 AMQP 数据帧时可能引发无限循环或内存破坏，从而导致拒绝服务（DoS）。

items.reason_en: Unlimited topic name depth triggers recursive CTrie operations, causing stack overflow and denial of service in MQTT brokers.
items.reason_zh: 主题名称深度无限制会触发递归的 CTrie 操作，导致 MQTT 代理服务器发生栈溢出并引发拒绝服务（DoS）。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in .NET and Visual Studio allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network. Vulnerabilities in core development frameworks and IDEs can compromise software supply chains and build pipelines.
items.reason_zh: .NET 和 Visual Studio 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可被用于通过网络进行未授权提权。核心开发框架与集成开发环境（IDE）中的此类漏洞可能危及软件供应链及构建流水线的安全。

items.reason_en: External file path control in .NET enables unauthorized privilege escalation over the network. Path traversal flaws in framework libraries can be chained with other vulnerabilities to achieve remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: .NET 存在外部文件路径控制不当问题，可导致通过网络进行未授权提权。框架库中的路径遍历缺陷若与其他漏洞组合利用，可实现远程代码执行（RCE）。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Xbox Gaming Services allows local privilege escalation, affecting the security model of Microsoft's gaming ecosystem.
items.reason_zh: Xbox Gaming Services 存在授权逻辑缺陷，可导致本地提权，进而影响微软游戏生态系统的安全架构。

items.reason_en: Failing open behavior in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized network security feature bypass, weakening IDE sandboxing and extension validation.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 存在失败开放（Failing Open）行为，可导致未授权绕过网络安全机制，削弱集成开发环境的沙箱隔离与扩展验证能力。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in Visual Studio Code enables unauthorized network security feature bypass, complicating traffic inspection and policy enforcement.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 存在 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞，可导致未授权绕过网络安全机制，增加流量检测与策略执行的复杂度。

items.reason_en: Critical use-after-free in Windows DNS enables remote code execution by unauthorized attackers, threatening core network resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 存在关键的使用后释放（Use-After-Free）漏洞，可使未授权攻击者实现远程代码执行，严重威胁核心网络解析基础设施的安全。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the RPC Runtime allows remote code execution over the network, compromising inter-process communication and system stability.
items.reason_zh: RPC 运行时存在越界写入漏洞，可被用于通过网络实现远程代码执行，破坏进程间通信机制并危及系统稳定性。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Windows Remote Desktop Services via use-after-free grants full system control to unauthenticated attackers over the network.
items.reason_zh: Windows Remote Desktop Services 存在基于使用后释放的远程代码执行漏洞，可使未经验权的攻击者通过网络获取完整的系统控制权。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in Windows Kerberos undermines enterprise identity management, enabling lateral movement and unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: Windows Kerberos 存在通过抓包重放实现的认证绕过漏洞，将破坏企业身份管理体系，助长攻击者的横向移动与未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Key Distribution Center allows remote code execution, directly impacting Active Directory ticket issuance and network security.
items.reason_zh: 密钥分发中心（KDC）存在使用后释放漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，直接影响 Active Directory 票据签发流程与整体网络安全。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in NTFS permits remote code execution during file system operations, risking data integrity and system compromise.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可在文件系统操作期间被用于远程代码执行，严重威胁数据完整性并可能导致系统沦陷。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Eclipse NetX Secure DTLS parser leaks sensitive session data during the initial handshake phase.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse NetX Secure DTLS 解析器存在越界读取漏洞，会在初始握手阶段泄露敏感会话数据。

items.reason_en: Downloaded pip and setuptools wheels in virtualenv lack authoritative digest verification, creating supply chain compromise risks.
items.reason_zh: virtualenv 中下载的 pip 与 setuptools wheel 包缺乏权威的摘要校验机制，存在供应链投毒风险。

items.reason_en: Linked list removal bug in GDB's STABS parser corrupts debug information for C++ classes, hindering secure software analysis.
items.reason_zh: GDB 的 STABS 解析器存在链表删除缺陷，会破坏 C++ 类的调试信息，阻碍安全软件分析工作。

items.reason_en: Elevation of privilege in Microsoft Defender ('ShieldBreak') disables core security controls, allowing attackers to bypass anti-malware protections locally.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Defender（代号 ShieldBreak）存在提权漏洞，可导致核心安全控件失效，使攻击者能够在本地绕过反恶意软件防护。

items.reason_en: Improper privilege management in Windows Package Manager allows local privilege escalation during software installation, undermining system integrity controls.
items.reason_zh: Windows Package Manager 存在权限管理缺陷，可在软件安装过程中导致本地提权，破坏系统完整性管控机制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Local Security Authority Server (lsasrv) enables remote code execution. Targeting LSASS directly facilitates credential dumping and domain-wide compromise.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Local Security Authority Server (lsasrv) 存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行。直接利用该漏洞针对 LSASS 将便利凭据提取并导致整个域被攻破。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Active Directory Certificate Services allows remote code execution. Compromising PKI infrastructure undermines certificate trust chains and enables man-in-the-middle attacks.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Certificate Services 存在使用后释放漏洞，可导致远程代码执行。该漏洞若被利用将破坏公钥基础设施（PKI）的信任链，并支持中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows Schannel allows local privilege escalation. Flaws in the secure channel library weaken TLS implementations and may expose cryptographic operations to memory corruption attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Schannel 存在使用后释放漏洞，可导致本地提权。安全通道库中的缺陷将削弱 TLS 实现的安全性，并可能使加密操作面临内存破坏攻击的风险。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows Kerberos allows local privilege escalation. Weakening the primary Windows authentication protocol increases the risk of ticket forgery and unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: Windows Kerberos 存在使用后释放漏洞，可导致本地提权。该漏洞将削弱 Windows 核心身份验证协议的安全性，增加票据伪造与未授权访问的风险。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited telnet daemon vulnerability allows remote authentication bypass, posing an immediate threat to legacy systems.
items.reason_zh: telnet 守护进程存在已被活跃利用的漏洞，可导致远程认证绕过，对传统系统构成直接安全威胁。

items.reason_en: Electron framework flaw exposes Web Workers to Node.js integration when disabled, risking code execution in desktop applications.
items.reason_zh: Electron 框架存在缺陷，当特定功能被禁用时会将 Web Workers 暴露给 Node.js 集成环境，危及桌面应用程序的代码执行安全。

items.reason_en: Insecure configuration handling in simple-git allows attackers to bypass safety plugins and inject dangerous Git operations.
items.reason_zh: simple-git 存在不安全的配置处理缺陷，可使攻击者绕过安全插件并注入危险的 Git 操作指令。

items.reason_en: Ollama's experimental agent mode fails to properly parse shell syntax, allowing prompt injection to trigger unauthorized shell command execution.
items.reason_zh: Ollama 的实验性代理模式未能正确解析 Shell 语法，易受提示词注入攻击，从而触发未授权的 Shell 命令执行。

items.reason_en: Socket.IO cluster engine uses inherited object properties for session ID lookups, enabling prototype pollution attacks that resolve attacker-controlled identifiers.
items.reason_zh: Socket.IO 集群引擎在会话 ID 查找时使用继承的对象属性，易受原型污染攻击，导致攻击者可控制标识符的解析结果。

items.reason_en: Signed integer overflow in klauspost/compress bypasses repeat index validation, potentially causing denial of service or memory corruption during dictionary encoding.
items.reason_zh: klauspost/compress 中的有符号整数溢出可绕过重复索引验证，在字典编码过程中可能导致拒绝服务或内存损坏。
